map.年期修正系数为什么≤1？: Why is the term adjustment factor ≤1?
map.使用年限越短价值越低，系数=(1−(1+r)^−实际)/(1−(1+r)^−上限: A shorter use term means lower value; the factor=(1−(1+r)^−actual)/(1−(1+r)^−cap) equals 1 at the cap and is below 1 when short.
